system_type.description: Target system type: 'live' (default) or 'installer'. When 'installer', the system migrates to a larger disk on first boot.

kernel_package.description: Name of the kernel package to install (e.g., 'linux-image-amd64'). If empty, a distribution-default kernel is used.

hostname.description: Hostname to assign to the embedded system.

kernel_bootargs.description: List of kernel boot arguments (strings). Each string may start with '+' (add), '-' (remove), or neither (add). Example: ['+console=ttyS0', '-rootdelay'].

root_password_ask.description: If true, prompt for root password during image generation.

root_password_none.description: If true, disable root password (no login prompt required).

root_password_first_boot.description: If true, prompt for root password on first boot.

grub_on_serial_line.description: If true, configure GRUB to output boot menu to serial line (PC-specific).

disk_layout.description: Path to a custom disk layout configuration file.

run_on_first_boot.description: Path (relative to chroot root) to a script to run on first boot after migration/resizing.

sector_size.description: Logical sector size (in bytes) of the target device (e.g., 512 or 4096). Default is 512.

source.description: Path to the source chroot environment directory.

dest.description: Path to the output bootable image file.
